description: Throwaway engine test for wearable items: a hi-vis vest and a guard jacket put on and taken off from the inventory, a worn frame in the tray, one costume at a time, no change while a member of staff watches, and the costume coming off when the item is dropped or taken away. Generic office, nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove put on and take off (costume, worn global, the worn frame and its label), one item worn at a time, unseenOnly refusing a change with a person NPC in the room and allowing it alone or with an ignored teammate, a drop or a remove_item taking the costume off, the wear and take_off actions, and the worn state after a reload
